boundary: The focused native input receives physical Command+2 on its main-thread key handler, but Lynxtron 0.0.21 cannot safely bridge that handler to the background model-selection listener through either runOnBackground or instance.triggerEvent. The native Menu accelerator remains suppressed while the input is focused. Model-picker numeric jumps therefore remain an R5 runtime gap; no tested-but-crashing implementation is retained.
